description: This file is a Go source file implementing a test helper library for the Mattermost server, providing setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing components such as database stores, search engines, and resource management.

classes.name: MainHelper
classes.description: A helper class for setting up and managing test environment components such as database, search engine, and resources.

classes.name: HelperOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for MainHelper, controlling store, resources, and parallel test execution.

methods.name: MainHelper
methods.description: Constructor for MainHelper, initializes environment variables and default settings.

methods.name: NewMainHelper
methods.description: Creates a new MainHelper instance with default options.

methods.name: NewMainHelperWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a new MainHelper instance with specified options, setting up environment and resources accordingly.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Runs the test suite, managing working directory and logger shutdown.

methods.name: GetNewStores
methods.description: Provides new store, SQL store, settings, and search engine instances for tests.

methods.name: setupStore
methods.description: Initializes store and search engine components for testing.

methods.name: ToggleReplicasOff
methods.description: Disables database read replicas for testing.

methods.name: ToggleReplicasOn
methods.description: Enables database read replicas for testing.

methods.name: PreloadMigrations
methods.description: Preloads database migrations to optimize test startup.

methods.name: PreloadMigrations
methods.description: Wrapper to preload migrations using current settings.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closes database connections, and exits test process.

methods.name: GetSQLSettings
methods.description: Returns SQL settings, panics if not initialized.

methods.name: GetStore
methods.description: Returns store interface, panics if not initialized.

methods.name: GetSQLStore
methods.description: Returns SQL store, panics if not initialized.

methods.name: GetClusterInterface
methods.description: Returns cluster interface, panics if not initialized.

methods.name: GetSearchEngine
methods.description: Returns search engine broker, panics if not initialized.

methods.name: Parallel
methods.description: Runs test in parallel if enabled in options.
